citation: Kinoshita M, Maeo S, Kobayashi Y, Eihara Y, Nishizawa N, Kusagawa Y, Sugiyama T, Wakahara T, Kanehisa H, Isaka T. Hypertrophic Effects of Single- versus Multi-Joint Exercise: A Direct Comparison between Knee Extension and Leg Press. Med Sci Sports Exerc. 2026;58(7):1566-1580.
design: Within-subject training study (one leg per exercise, legs counterbalanced); MRI assessors blinded; plus a separate EMG experiment
n: 17 (11 men, 6 women; 34 legs); EMG experiment 11 men
population: Untrained healthy young adults (no knee extension, leg press or squat training in the past 12 months)
intervention_comparison: Single-leg knee extension vs single-leg seated leg press; 5 x 10 at 70% 1RM; both started at 90 deg hip and 90 deg knee flexion; leg press knee range 90-0 deg, hip 90-60 deg; hip-width foot position
outcome_measure: MRI muscle volume of 17 individual muscles (4 quadriceps heads, 3 gluteals, 4 hamstrings, adductors, sartorius, gracilis); 1RM
result_effect_uncertainty: Rectus femoris +13.2% (knee extension) vs +1.1% (leg press, P = 0.379 vs baseline), interaction P < 0.001. Vasti +5.0-7.2% vs +4.4-6.2%, whole quadriceps +7.1% vs +4.9% (P >= 0.319). Leg press only: gluteus maximus +15.4%, adductor magnus +6.2%, all gluteals +12.0%, all adductors +4.1% (P < 0.001); knee extension -0.9% to +0.2%. Gluteus medius (leg press 290.8 to 305.1 cm3, not significant), gluteus minimus, adductor longus (160.6 to 160.7 cm3) and brevis unchanged. Hamstrings as a group +1.5% and +3.2% (from table means). No confidence intervals for the percentage differences in the text read.
limitations_coi: Untrained; n = 17; within-subject; leg press used a shallow knee range (90 deg), so depth effects are untested; hip angle fixed at 90 deg for the knee extension (not leaning back). Funding: Yamaha Motor Foundation for Sports grant; no conflicts declared.
verification: PubMed PMID 41630124 abstract and author list retrieved 2026-11-17; Crossref DOI resolves 2026-11-17, no update-to/updated-by notice; Europe PMC full text PMC13215645 (methods, results table 1, limitations, funding) read 2026-11-17
